episodes.title: Tu les rêves
episodes.summary: Just as best-selling author Emma Larsimon announces she's done writing horror, an unnerving visit from an old friend draws her back to her hometown.

episodes.title: C'est coutume!
episodes.summary: While a quirky police inspector digs into her parents' case, Emma drags Camille back to Caro's home and reconnects with the rest of her old crew.

episodes.title: Je ne suis pas un cadeau
episodes.summary: Tonio makes a disturbing discovery at the shore. Another harrowing night with Emma pushes Camille to her limit. Marianne turns up the heat.

episodes.title: C'est un beau moment
episodes.summary: Emma's grieving is cut short by an urgent request, and a grisly scene at the Daugeron home leads Inspector Ronan into a world of demonic secrets.

episodes.title: Tu l'as laissée...
episodes.summary: Fifteen years earlier, in a bid to drive away Emma's nightmares, the friends gather at their old school for a ritual that will change their lives.

episodes.title: Pour les souvenirs?
episodes.summary: Inspector Ronan connects the dots between Emma's books and more real-world tragedies. He, Emma and Séby hatch a plan to destroy Marianne.

episodes.title: On était trop petit
episodes.summary: Fleeing to different parts of the island, the friends encounter terrifying sights and ghostly messengers. One by one, they turn on Emma.

episodes.title: On est mardi
episodes.summary: As the priest makes a desperate bid to banish Marianne, Emma finds herself torn between two worlds, and Aurore searches for a way to save her friend.
